load_metric: flow_mods = installs + deletes + demotes per episode (Packet-Ins reported)
selection: per base: fewest mean flow_mods over A1-A7 validation episodes among settings with mean benign harm (A1-A7 + benign) <= base + 0.0025; ties within 1 % of flow_mods: lower harm; none eligible: no hold
test_cells: A1-A7, benign and E9's three selected attacks; dedicated ports
comparison: dms-blocklist (revision 2 knobs B) as the load reference

hypotheses.HH1: load: each selected hold sends fewer flow-mods than its base under attack (A1-A7 and E9's attacks; paired cluster Wilcoxon, Holm), and at least 30 % fewer on T1 A2, the testbed case
hypotheses.HH2: harm: each selected hold is non-inferior to its base over A1-A7 + benign (cluster bootstrap 95 % upper bound of the mean harm difference <= 0.5 points)
hypotheses.HH3: adaptive: each selected hold's worst case over E9's attacks is at most its base's + 0.5 points
